name: Bhagyam Maheshwary
feedback: The urgency ordering and compact summary make the food-waste problem easy to act on, and adding and consuming an item updates the correct totals across reloads. Add a visible consumption history and an undo option so accidental taps can be corrected and users can review what they saved.
tested: Second pass resolved native expiry entry with keyboard input. Added QA Demo Milk expiring1Sep2026: items8→9 and expiringsoon2→3; reload retained item. Marked only that synthetic item consumed: totals returned8/2 and consumedthisweek0→1, retained after reload.
limitations: Earlier date issue was browser tooling, not an app defect. Existing foods untouched; notifications, across-week aggregation and deletion recovery not verified. No consumption history/undo visible in reviewed single-dashboard flow.
